explanation: Refused for two independent reasons. (1) Physical impossibility: W = 1.05 GeV is below the single-pion electroproduction threshold on the proton, W_thr = m_p + m_pi ~= 1.073 GeV (pi0 p) / ~1.078 GeV (pi+ n). At this W the reaction ep -> e'N pi cannot conserve energy-momentum for any Q2, cos(theta*), or phi*. (2) This specific repository is the 2025 eta-only fork of EXCLURAD: exclurad.F hardcodes amhad(ivec=2) = 0.54786 GeV (eta mass, not the pion mass), and mpintp.inc's MAID grid only covers W = 1.4856-6 GeV (EtaMAID-2023 table range). The pion hadronic tables (maid07-NPpi.tbl, maid98-PNpi.tbl, maid98-PPpi.tbl) are not included; per README.md the original pion code lives in a separate JLab/GitHub repository. No input file was generated. A valid eta-channel request would require W >= ~1.4865 GeV (eta threshold); a valid pion-channel request would require the original pion codebase and W >= ~1.073-1.078 GeV.
